final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry and filtering only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). I converted timestamps to UTC ISO 8601 format with 'Z' suffix. I extracted the service name, normalized level to uppercase, and extracted the message after "<service>: " on the first line. For entries with tracebacks, I extracted the last line as the exception; otherwise, I set exception to null. I calculated repeat_count by adding 1 plus any repeated message counts following the entry. I aggregated counts by service summing repeat_count. The errors are sorted by service name and timestamp ascending. The output file workspace/errors.json follows the Acme log-triage conventions and includes schema_version and generated_by metadata.

checks.name: rule_service_names
checks.detail: RULE: service names in the output are lower-case with '-' replaced by '_' (payment-service -> payment_service).

checks.name: rule_sorted_errors
checks.detail: RULE: `errors` is sorted by service, then by timestamp_utc, ascending.
